an4.35:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
an4.35:1.2: Atha kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Magadhamahāmatto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.35:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vassakāro brāhmaṇo Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca :
an4.35:2.1: Catuhi kho mayaṃ bho Gotama dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema.
an4.35:2.3: Idha bho Gotama bahussuto hoti, tassa tass' eva sutajātassa
an4.35:2.4: tass' eva kho pano bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti: ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho ti.
an4.35:2.5: Satimā kho pana hoti cirakatam pi cirabhāsitam pi saritā anussarita
an4.35:2.6: yāni kho pana tāni gahaṭṭhakāni kiṃkaraṇiyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso, tatr' upāyavīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
an4.35:2.7: Imehi kho mayaṃ bho Gotama catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema.
an4.35:2.8: Sace me pana bho Gotama anumoditabbaṃ anumodatu me bhavaṃ Gotamo,
an4.35:2.9: sace pana me bhavaṃ Gotamo paṭikkositabbaṃ paṭikkosatu pana me bhavaṃ Gotamo ti. 3.
an4.35:3.1: N' eva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa anumodāmi na paṭikkosāmi.
an4.35:3.2: Catuhi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemi.
an4.35:3.4: Idha brāhmaṇa bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya
an4.35:3.5: bahu 'ssa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇa-dhammatā kusala-dhammatā
an4.35:3.6: so yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi,
an4.35:3.7: yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
an4.35:3.9: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukha-vihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an4.35:3.10: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.35:3.11: N' eva kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa anumodāmi na paṭikkosāmi.
an4.35:3.12: Imehi kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemīti. 4.
an4.35:4.1: Acchariyaṃ bho Gotama abbhutaṃ bho Gotama
an4.35:4.2: yāva subhāsitaṃ c' idaṃ bhotā Gotamena.
an4.35:4.3: Imehi ca mayaṃ catuhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ dhārema,
an4.35:4.4: bhavaṃ hi Gotamo bahujanahitāya paṭipanno bahujanasukhāya
an4.35:4.5: bahu te janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā,
an4.35:4.6: bhavaṃ hi Gotamo yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
an4.35:4.7: Bhavaṃ hi Gotamo cetovasippatto vitakkapathesu. bhavaṃ
an4.35:4.8: hi Gotamo catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābbhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an4.35:4.9: bhavaṃ hi Gotamo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme . . . viharatīti. 5.
an4.35:5.1: Addhā kho tyāhaṃ brāhmaṇa āsajja upanīyavācā bhāsitā
an4.35:5.4: bahu me janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā yadidaṃ kalyāṇa-dhammatā kusaladhammatā.
an4.35:5.5: Ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ tam vitakkaṃ vitakkemi yaṃ vitakkaṃ nakaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi.
an4.35:5.6: Ahaṃ hi brāhmaṇa cetovasippato vitakkapathesu, ahaṃ
an4.35:5.7: hi brāhmaṇa catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānam . . . akasiralābhī,
an4.35:5.8: aham hi brāhmaṇa āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme . . . viharāmīti. 6.
an4.35:6.5: Yaṃ ve disvā ca sutvā ca
